The Rune-Locked Door — Seven interlocking rings of relic-script guard the door, each ring a name of something the world has already forgotten.
The Vault Guardians Wake — Animated armor and restless bones rise from alcoves as the vault begins to seal itself, stone grinding shut behind you.
The Sovereign's Antechamber — Beyond the guardians, the Hollow Sovereign waits on a throne built from six erased crowns, the seventh relic pulsing at its chest.
The Hollow Sovereign — The Sovereign rises, wearing the shape of a king who is mostly absence now, the seventh relic the only solid thing about him.
The Seventh Relic — With the Sovereign fallen, the seventh relic lies exposed and humming, still hungry, still able to unmake or remake in equal measure.
